string.value:
#cIncreases the damage# for Lucky Seven, Drain, Avenger and Shadow Meso.
Also, there is a chance that throwing stars will not be consumed, and a chance to #crecharge 1 throwing star#.
(You cannot recharge beyond the maximum number of throwing stars. Does not apply to Spirit Javelins.)
When Expert Throwing Star Handling is activated, #cthe next attack will always be a Critical Attack#.
Required Skill: #cSpirit Javelin Lv. 5#
